answer_1.quote: We leverage the generation ability of pre-trained language models to save endangered cultural heritage, i.e., Chinese Comical Crosstalk... we conduct several basic generation approaches including train-from-scratch Seq2seq generation, fine-tuned middle-scale PLMs, and large-scale PLMs.

answer_2.quote: We adopted several widely-used metrics to measure the quality of the generated response. BLEU-1/2/4 ... ROUGE-1/2/L ... GLEU ... Distinct-1/2 ... BERT-score and Bart-score ...

answer_4.quote: Participants are required to 1) rate five-point scores for the general quality and humor degree of each generated script ... and 2) rate binary scores for coherence and an ethically-risky flag of each generated example.
answer_4.guideline: Rate five-point scores for general quality and humor degree; rate binary (1/0) for coherence and ethical risk.
